name: BankMarketing_FinancialPhraseBank_Alignment
description: Weakly aligns bank marketing subscription outcomes with financial sentiment texts based on semantic plausibility.
rationale: Customers who subscribe to a term deposit (target=1) demonstrate financial capability and receptiveness, which aligns smoothly with favorable (positive) financial sentiment. Conversely, customers who decline (target=0) reflect the default state of rejection, lack of interest, or economic constraint, making them semantically suited for neutral or unfavorable (negative) financial text.
